title: Trust Him With the Path
excerpt: Trust with all my heart — not with the part of my heart that has it figured out, and not after I’ve mapped the whole route. My own understanding has led me in circles for 34 years. “Trust in the LORD with all your heart; do not depend on your own understanding. Seek his will in all you do, and he will show you which path to take.” — Proverbs 3:5-6

title: Overflowing with Hope
excerpt: Hope here isn’t something I have to manufacture. God is the source of it, and He fills me with it — joy and peace first, because I trust Him, and then hope overflows out of that. “I pray that God, the source of hope, will fill you completely with joy and peace because you trust in him. Then you will overflow with confident hope through the power of the Holy Spirit.” — Romans 15:13

title: A New Life Has Begun
excerpt: God doesn’t say “Try harder to become a better version of your old self.” He says a new person. “This means that anyone who belongs to Christ has become a new person. The old life is gone; a new life has begun!” — 2 Corinthians 5:17

title: Be Still
excerpt: God didn’t say “hurry up and know that I am God.” He says be still. “Be still, and know that I am God! I will be honored by every nation. I will be honored throughout the world.” — Psalm 46:10

title: Be Strong and Courageous
excerpt: God didn't tell Joshua to be strong because the road ahead was easy. He told him because it wasn't. “This is my command—be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid or discouraged. For the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.” — Joshua 1:9

title: Wait Patiently
excerpt: Waiting is not the same as doing nothing. It takes courage to wait — to not force a door open just because I’m tired of standing in the hallway. “Wait patiently for the LORD. Be brave and courageous. Yes, wait patiently for the LORD.” — Psalm 27:14

title: Show Me Where to Walk
excerpt: Most of recovery doesn’t happen on the big days. It happens on ordinary ones — a quiet morning, a clear head, and a hundred small decisions nobody sees. “Show me where to walk, for I give myself to you.” — Psalm 143:8

title: A Day the Lord Has Made
excerpt: A birthday can make you look back at everything that went wrong — the years lost, the people hurt, the chances missed. “This is the day the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it.” — Psalm 118:24

title: Don’t Give Up Before the Harvest
excerpt: Some days in recovery feel like you’re doing the right things and nothing seems to be changing. “So let’s not get tired of doing what is good.” — Galatians 6:9

title: Strength for Today
excerpt: Seventy-five days in, I still don't have it all figured out — and that's okay. “Fear not, for I am with you.” — Isaiah 41:10
This morning I woke up grateful for a mercy I didn't earn and a fresh start I didn't deserve. “They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.” — Lamentations 3:22–23
title: New Mercies Every Morning
